fusions.name: Off the Leash
fusions.desc: Runs a target down from up to 7 tiles away, dealing 14 damage, up to 1.5 times that from the full distance.

fusions.name: Heel Nip
fusions.desc: Nips at the target's heels, dealing 4 damage and leaving it 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds, with a 25% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: At a Whistle
fusions.desc: Whistles up a hound that runs with you for 18 seconds, biting an enemy within 4 tiles for 5 damage every 1.2 seconds. You move 20% faster for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Scent of the Wounded
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage.
